entries.title: Japan's Position on Taiwan has Not Changed, PM Takaichi Says
entries.paragraph_1: Published on Thursday, 19 Nov 2026 09:47 by EO
entries.paragraph_2: SHENZHEN, China (Reuters) - Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, speaking in southern China, said on Thursday 19 November 2026 that her country's position on Taiwan had not changed since 1972. Takaichi's comments on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen come as relations between China and Japan remain in a deep freeze since her Taiwan-related remarks in November 2025. She said then that a hypothetical Chinese attack on democratically ruled Taiwan could trigger a military response from Tokyo. On Thursday, Takaichi said there had been no change to Japan's position on Taiwan as stated in its 1972 Japan-China Joint Communiqué, which established diplomatic relations between the two countries. Under the 1972 communiqué, Japan said it "fully understands and respects" Beijing's position that Taiwan is a part of China. "There has been absolutely no change to this position," Takaichi told a press conference. China has demanded she retract what it called her "egregious" remarks last year, warning that otherwise Japan "must bear all consequences" for the comments. It has also restricted exports of critical minerals, banned imports of Japanese seafood and urged its citizens not to travel to Japan. Until now, Japanese leaders have avoided mentioning Taiwan when publicly discussing such scenarios, maintaining a strategic ambiguity. Unlike other leaders including US President Donald Trump, Takaichi did not hold a bilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit. She said she had expressed thanks for the invite to Xi during one of her brief encounters with him for greetings, highlighting that China is "an important neighbour" for Japan to engage and communicate with.

entries.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO by board - Times of Oman
entries.paragraph_1: New Delhi : Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has opted to resign amidst mounting pressure, reported Reuters. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, the company said on Thursday. Huang has been in the eye of a storm after it was revealed that he had an affair with Alice Huang (not his relation) a Chinese businesswoman who is alleged to be a intelligence asset. Jensen Huang was also reported have had another affair with a senior executive of Nvidia Kimberly Powell. Jensen Huang had acknowledged his affair with Alice Huang in a letter to Nvidia employees where he apologised for being unfaithful to his wife and violating her trust. Nvidia's board had also initiated an investigation into the matter, with the inquiry being led by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. In May 2026 a Wall Street 'Short seller' Culper research had flagged Huang's alleged links to Alice Huang. According to CBS News, on May 13 this year Culper Research published a 40-page report highlighting Huang's ties to Alice Huang, a former television reporter and financial industry executive. According to the report, a copy of which is with ANI, Culper research said, "Nvidia has repeatedly vouched for Megaspeed – its single largest Southeast Asian chip buyer currently under investigation by both U.S. Commerce and Singapore authorities." "Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has not only vouched for Megaspeed, but seems to have quite literally walked alongside Megaspeed at every step, while maintaining an uncomfortably close relationship with Megaspeed’s Alice Huang, a Chinese national. He was first spotted partying with Alice Huang in June 2024 – the same month the Apex/Alibaba pledge was filed. He then dined with Alice Huang in Taiwan in May 2025 – just weeks after the news of U.S. trade restrictions. Finally, per one current Megaspeed employee, Jensen visits Megaspeed-linked data centers “every few months” and “every single time” he visits, he is accompanied by representatives from Alibaba. The Megaspeed employee characterised their relationship with Jensen as “very close”, corroborating another former Nvidia employee’s suggestion to us that many Nvidia employees wondered if there was a special relationship," the report stated. Although Jensen Huang had got the backing of US President Donald Trump he was under extreme pressure with members of the US Congress flagging potential security risk of the affair with the alleged spy. Jensen Huang's exit puts the $4 trillion Nvidia in troubled waters and could potentially disrupt the AI industry which has been facing headwinds on the markets recently.

entries.title: La noche triste de Trump | Noticias
entries.paragraph_1: Como nos advirtió Heráclito, en este universo nada es permanente, pero incluso el filósofo griego se habría sorprendido ante la rapidez con la que cambian las cosas en el mundo político actual en que lo que un día parece inevitable puede esfumarse por  completo el siguiente. Hace apenas dos años, muchos analistas norteamericanos daban por moribundo al Partido Demócrata, cuya candidata, Kamala Harris, acababa de sufrir una contundente derrota en la contienda presidencial frente a un resurgido Donald Trump. Sin embargo, a pesar de seguir divididos y sin darse el trabajo de modificar sus propuestas, los demócratas lograron recuperarse lo suficiente como para cosechar una victoria espectacular en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de la semana pasada.
entries.paragraph_2: Desde entonces, quienes predijeron la inminente desaparición del Partido Demócrata están diciendo prácticamente lo mismo sobre el Republicano y, claro está, sobre el propio Trump, para quien los resultados fueron un desastre absoluto. Durante al menos los próximos dos años, demócratas sedientos de revancha, cuyo odio y desprecio hacia Trump no conocen límites, controlarán ambas cámaras del Congreso. Algunos intentarán someterlo a un juicio político con la esperanza de destituirlo, otros se conformarán con hacer todo lo posible por obligarlo a suavizar su postura en cuestiones como la inmigración ilegal -algo que, para sorpresa de muchos, dice estar dispuesto a hacer-, además de cohonestar las cuotas raciales destinadas a favorecer a minorías étnicas, garantizar los derechos adquiridas de las personas transexuales y otros temas que obsesionan a los activistas.

entries.title: A estratégia para tomar Taiwan
entries.paragraph_1: A China já não esconde que pretende incorporar Taiwan ao seu território. O presidente Xi Jinping acaba de reafirmar que a reunificação da ilha com o continente é inevitável . A declaração, feita nesta quinta-feira, 12, um dia depois de os ministros das Relações Exteriores do G-7 condenarem o aumento da pressão militar e marítima chinesa sobre Taiwan, não deixa dúvidas sobre as intenções de Pequim. Mais do que palavras, porém, são os preparativos militares que despertam preocupação internacional. Tudo indica que a China está construindo, passo a passo, as condições para uma operação destinada a colocar a ilha sob seu controle, inclusive pela força.
entries.paragraph_2: Um dos sinais mais preocupantes é a construção, em território chinês, em uma área desértica, de réplicas de instalações estratégicas taiwanesas. Imagens de satélite revelaram uma reprodução de áreas centrais de Taipé, incluindo edifícios governamentais e o entorno do gabinete presidencial. Não se trata de simples treinamento militar. Analistas militares identificam nesses exercícios a preparação para uma operação de decapitação: capturar ou eliminar a liderança política e militar do adversário nas primeiras horas de um conflito.

entries.title: Nvidia Chip Packaging Deal Funds SPIL Lines Making AI Chip Interposer Wafers, Not Just Assembly
entries.paragraph_1: Nvidia is funding new production lines at Taiwanese chip-packaging company SPIL that cover bumping, interposer wafer fabrication , assembly and testing, according to the agreement Nvidia announced Tuesday. An interposer is the silicon routing layer that connects an AI processor to its memory stacks. Making interposers has typically been TSMC's CoWoS front-end step , so the scope points to Nvidia financing a second source for part of the front half of an AI chip package, not only more back-end floor space. Neither company has said how the interposers will be made or under what license.
entries.paragraph_2: Nvidia released the multiyear agreements at 5:18 p.m. ET Tuesday, naming six partners: Amkor, Foxconn, Kinsus, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and TSMC. SPIL said Wednesday in Taiwan that it will triple its advanced packaging capacity there by mid-2029, and Nvidia described its funding as multibillion-dollar without giving a figure.

entries.title: Xi pede que EUA 'façam a coisa certa' sobre Taiwan; Trump diz não apoiar independência da ilha - 19/11/2026 | Diário do Grande ABC
entries.paragraph_1: Quinta-Feira, 19 de Novembro de 2026
entries.paragraph_2: O presidente da China, Xi Jinping, discutiu a questão de Taiwan em encontro com o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, nesta quinta-feira, 19. Xi afirmou que Washington deve "fazer a coisa certa" em relação à ilha, de acordo com comunicado do Ministério das Relações Exteriores chinês. Na conversa, Xi pediu que os Estados Unidos evitem provocar grandes turbulências nas relações bilaterais. Trump afirmou que Washington não apoia a independência de Taiwan, informou a chancelaria chinesa. Em relato publicado pela agência de notícias Xinhua , Xi também afirmou que uma guerra nuclear não pode ser vencida e nunca deve ser travada. Ele defendeu que todos os esforços sejam feitos para evitar esse tipo de conflito e pediu respeito ao Tratado de Não Proliferação de Armas Nucleares, a fim de preservar a estabilidade estratégica global. O líder chinês defendeu ainda a continuidade da cooperação entre os dois países no combate ao tráfico de drogas, na deportação de imigrantes em situação irregular e no enfrentamento de fraudes por meio de telecomunicações e da internet. Trump afirmou que as relações comerciais e de investimento entre as duas potências estão se fortalecendo e destacou os avanços da cooperação em áreas como o combate ao tráfico de fentanil. Xi ressaltou, contudo, que a construção de uma relação estratégica estável e construtiva exige novas iniciativas, disposição para assumir riscos e compromisso com resultados concretos. Para ele, implementar os entendimentos alcançados pelos dois chefes de Estado é fundamental para preservar a atual trajetória positiva das relações bilaterais.
